form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.notes: Born-digital fillable form, typed figures. Boxes B-F are printed with a leading '$' and a thousands comma ('$6,200'); per the spec the '$' is dropped and the comma kept verbatim. Box A is printed as a bare '0' and Balance at Close as '$0'. The Office field prints the seat letter in straight double quotes: Utah County Commission Seat "C". The report-type checkbox marked is '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination', consistent with index.csv's 'Eliminated or Withdrawn'. Address/city/state/zip are redacted upstream by the county (a single black bar across the whole row), so residence_city is ''. The signature is an Adobe digital signature reading 'Digitally signed by Andrew K Jackson / Date: 2024.05.19 15:45:46 -06'00'' - one day AFTER the 05/18/24 the filer typed in the Date and Date of Report boxes; report_date follows the form's own date fields as printed.
